phases.objective: Identify a concrete bounded NROM hardware smoke path and the matching existing board and artifacts.
required: Inspect production227 and actual existing FPGA/ARM/65816 artifacts, fit, timing, pin/clock and version provenance; do not assume they already ran on hardware
Define minimal image, input/audio/STOP/recovery and measurable frame/capture indicators
Document resident memory/stack, package, dependencies, reproducible build and safe restoration of GBC/save
Determine which actual FIT/STA/CDC/IO and board checks are still required
phases.exit: A reviewable bounded package and measured or explicitly missing prerequisites; no deployment or physical 60fps claim.

phases.objective: Compare a real broad joint replacement of 402 against at least one simpler relocation of work to ARM and/or SNES at the same product boundary.
required: Identify existing control bodies actually removed, retained independent checks and data origins
Charge wire bytes, ARM instructions/IRQ/stack, SNES service/DMA/VBlank, fixed RAM ports, CDC, program RAM and FF/LUT packing
Use common benchmark and target device, distinguish area estimates from measured whole MAP and device fit
Define the smallest decisive connected experiment and failure/stop criteria for each candidate
Make MMC4/5 request and ROM contention representative samples explicit
phases.exit: Select only an evidence-backed implementation or recommend revisiting role split, scope or FPGA capacity; no free deleted logic or free time.

phases.objective: Implement the selected candidate at a real deletion boundary, not a second unused engine.
required: Independent expected versus actual consumption, duplicate/missing-read, credit versus consumed receipt, staged header publication
Two clock domains and physical RAM ports, input and old-display identity, STOP and late DONE
Actual ARM/SPI/IRQ/ROM, 2 slots, actual SNES service and correct next VBlank targets
Compare same initial capture/ROM phases and continuous schedule, document starting phase separately
Quartus Lite whole MAP on identical functionally verified sources, all memory and controls charged
phases.exit: Only a candidate satisfying both legal schedule/capture and whole area enters fit; if materially short, stop micro-tuning and return to architecture decision.

phases.objective: Build a matching, recoverable limited hardware smoke package when a specific implementation meets board prerequisites.
required: Whole FIT and STA on actual candidate
CDC and external IO/clock review
Pinned FPGA, ARM and SNES images with RAM/stack, input/audio and STOP
Record boot, output, input, audio, STOP/restart and restore behavior
Measure frame IDs, capture/drop/repeat and timing on actual regional clock
phases.exit: A bounded hardware finding only, not a 60fps or general mapper claim.

phases.objective: Demonstrate sustained cadence and progressively broaden mapper coverage.
required: 918+, heavy-frame and 71-frame whole-path tests with multiple phases, actual ARM/IRQ/ROM and SNES service
Separate startup and gameplay/STOP recovery
Real physical frame/capture IDs, repeat/drop counts and worst latency
MMC4/5 actual implementation and representative ROM competition; broaden tests before compatibility claims
phases.exit: Sustained physical cadence with no unexplained missed/repeated frames and scoped mapper coverage; actual timing evidence, not a simulated average.
